runs.text:
Welcome to the world of HEAVY METAL!!!

The label LIMB MUSIC started back in 1997 with the release of “Legendary Tales”, the debut album of a then unknown Italian band by the name of RHAPSODY. This set the pace for the years to come, as the label still specializes in all kinds of Melodic Heavy Metal, such as Power, True, Speed, Symphonic, Progressive, etc. - Basically the music, managing director R. Limb Schnoor knows best - and not only because of his work as manager for the likes of HELLOWEEN, MANIA, HEAVENS GATE, ELDRITCH, VIPER and ANGRA in the 80s and 90s.

The artist roster over the years consisted of, amongst others, RHAPSODY, LUCA TURILLI, ANCIENT BARDS, HEAVENS GATE, ASTRALION, DANIELE MAZZA, BLACK MAJESTY, DRAGONY, FIREWÖLFE, MASTERS OF DISGUISE, ROXXCALIBUR, SYMPHONITY.

To this day, promising newcomers as well as established bands like MOONLIT MASQUERADE, Cristiano Filippini's FLAMES OF HEAVEN, MEMORIES OF OLD, WONDERS, PRYDAIN, FOGALORD, etc., find their home at LIMB MUSIC
